judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Two tidy, symmetrical fetch quests with elaborate comic set-ups (miners skipping supper, wives ready to skin him, a borrowed pin dropped down a crack) and exact payoffs ('100 gold from the company strongbox') read as a modern writer filling a town; Nox's campaign rarely builds side errands this neatly, and the masking leaks ('that bell', 'that pin') plus the she/he wobble add to the sense of a constructed text.
